meta_description: 18K likes, 214 comments - ted on October 24, 2026: "A bully’s power is borrowed power — and we can refuse to hand it over, says social psychologist @AmyCuddy. In her TED Talk, she recounts being relentlessly targeted in a public campaign, shares research on how quickly bullying spreads and explains why standing up for each other in small ways is the key to stopping it. Visit the link in our bio to watch her talk.".
